messages:
rachel: Heads-up: proposing a staged unpin of runtime 2.13 -> 2.16 for hosted canary at 01:00 UTC tonight. Aim is to pick up quant-batching perf wins but we saw a potential tail regression on longseq. Change window 01:00-04:00 UTC. Telemetry: https://internal/telemetry/3210-quant-tail
marta: Thanks. Prefer staged cohorts: dev (5%) -> low-traffic tenants (20%) -> broad canary (60%) -> full (if green). Also keep quant-v2 models routed to pinned runtime as a fallback.
ops-sre: I'll own monitoring/rollback. Rollback triggers: customer_error_rate increase >= 0.007 (0.7%) OR p95 latency >= baseline*1.30 sustained for 10m. On trigger: deploybot pin runtime=2.13 cohort=canary and page #incidents/@oncall.
zane: SDK impact: SDK 3.1.x clients using early KV warm hints may see higher miss rates under new kernel. Propose server honors header `X-RW-Compat: legacy` to preserve previous warm semantics for tagged clients. Add to changelog.
jules: QA plan: run longseq + burst tests against canary path at /qa/longseq/3210. I'll run smoke after the first 20m stage and post results.
rachel: Rollout plan: 01:00 start -> 5% for 20m -> 20% for 25m -> 60% for 40m -> 100% if green. Release notes draft: https://internal/notes/rel-3210101010 (will add compat header details). Tagging @support and @product for customer comms.
deploybot: schedule created by @rachel. job id: deploy-3210101010-01. To cancel: `/deploy cancel deploy-3210101010-01`. Automated rollback policy attached to job.
ops-sre: Runbook snippet:
```
# rollback quick
if cust_err_rate >= 0.007 or p95_now >= p95_baseline*1.3 for 10m:
  deploybot pin runtime=2.13 cohort=canary
  post to #incidents with summary + link to traces
  escalate to eng-runtime and eng-ml leads
```
zane: I have a tiny SDK shim ready to flip legacy header auto-detection if rollback happens. Won't ship pre-window.
marta: Ops checklist: enable flags `feature.unpin_3210` and `trace.kvcache_canary`; increase trace retention to 2h for cohort.
jules: QA note: observed baseline p95 for longseq on quant-v2 in staging is 420ms. We'll watch p95 delta closely.
rachel: OK proceeding with 01:00 window and staged unpin. Everyone ack if you're on-monitor.
marta: ack
jules: ack (will post smoke results)
zane: ack
ops-sre: standing by; will post first-stage status ~01:25 UTC.
deploybot: automated: step1 (5%) scheduled at 3210102010, deploy-3210101010-01 queued.
